description:
Piñata Pop is a free Unity sample project you can download, explore, and learn from. Dig into a fully playable casual mobile game to see how Unity’s mobile and monetization features, like ads and in-app purchasing, blend together into one seamless mobile gaming experience.

🔗 Download the project: https://on.unity.com/PinataPop_AssetStore
🔗 Play the game: https://on.unity.com/PinataPop_UnityPlay
